question: If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘–’, then the resultant of which of the following will be 652?
solution:
BODMAS table

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘–’

Option 1) 109 B 6 D 16 A 2 C 6

Putting the sign in equation

⇒109 x 6 - 16 ÷ 2 + 6 

⇒109 x 6 - 8 + 6 

⇒654 - 8 + 6

⇒660 - 8

⇒652

Option2) 109 A 6 D 16 B 2 C 6

⇒109 ÷ 6 - 16 x 2 + 6

⇒18.16 - 16 x 2 + 6

⇒18.16 - 32 + 6

⇒24.16 - 32

⇒-7.84

Option3) 109 B 6 A 16 D 2 C 6

⇒109 x 6 ÷ 16 - 2 + 6

⇒109 x 0.375 - 2 + 6

⇒40.875 - 2 + 6

⇒46.875 - 2

⇒44.875

**Option 4)** 109 C 6 D 16 A 2 B 6

⇒109 + 6 - 16 ÷ 2 x 6

⇒109 + 6 - 8 x 6

⇒109 + 6 - 48

⇒115 - 48

⇒67

Hence the correct answer is "Option 1".
